(u0, siren_ringing) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0

(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, else) -> u2

Format: all required headers (REWARD_MACHINE, STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION, REWARD_FUNCTION) present; FINAL_STATES is nonempty (u2), u2 is declared in STATES, is a transition target, and is made accepting/absorbing by its else self-loop, so the header requirement is met. Reachability: u2 is reachable from u0 both when the siren never rings (siren-less setups) and after any number of ring/silence cycles; u1 is reachable exactly when the siren rings. Ordered-transition coverage: the u0<->u1 cycle handles the first ring, the optional second start after a silencing (another 0.1 on silencing), and the skip case (a second start while already ringing keeps the machine in u1, so one silencing yields exactly one bonus). Persistent/event distinction is correct: persistent siren_ringing holds the machine in u1 via the else loop; the event switch_toggled supplies the silencing edge, and since the siren stops only on a toggle, (u1, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) fires precisely on the silencing step (also on a step-limit toggle, which the environment still counts); last-step-only at_exit drives the terminal edge, and no ring can start on the ending step, so the terminal guard cannot be missed. Irrelevant propositions (holding_box, box_fell, and toggles while the siren is silent) are all absorbed by per-state else self-loops in u0, u1, and u2. Reward safety: every reward triple matches a declared transition; progress reward is bounded (at most two starts => at most 0.2 total) and unfarmable (repeated toggles while silent loop in u0 at 0; a toggle coinciding with a ring start correctly pays nothing because the ring fires after the action and the machine moves to u1); the terminal 1.0 is paid only on (u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing, u2). An exit while the siren is ringing leaves the machine in u1 with no reward, which is the right encoding of the unfulfilled duty 'each time the siren rings, switch it off' and mirrors the environment's 0 payment when the siren must be silent at exit; the box-side constraints (box_fell/holding_box, box_fell/at_exit) are vacuously respected. Non-blocking notes: (i) !siren_ringing in the u1 silencing guard is redundant, since a toggle in u1 always stops the siren, but it is harmless and defensive; (ii) the flat 1.0 terminal replaces the environment's time-scaled exit payment, which is acceptable because the RM specifies the learning reward rather than the environment payment; (iii) the u1 state deliberately has no at_exit transition - that absence is the failure encoding, not a reachability defect, since u2 remains reachable whenever the task is completed.

def siren_ringing(env): return env.siren_ringing

def switch_toggled(env): return "toggle" in env.events_this_step

def holding_box(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "box"

def box_fell(env): return "fall" in env.events_this_step

def at_exit(env): return env.grid.get(*env.agent_pos) is not None and env.grid.get(*env.agent_pos).type == "goal"
